title: East Side Office/Retail with Great Visibility
summary: Newly remodeled office/retail building at a signalized four-way intersection on Athens' east side, with strong visibility and grandfathered monument signage. It is leased through January 31, 2028, so it suits an investor keeping the tenant or an owner-user planning ahead.
highlights: Signalized four-way intersection with high visibility
alt: Office and retail building at 710 Gaines School Road, Athens, Georgia
